Name: Slightly Cuter Sprites for Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE)
Author: somohexual
Description:
[size=4][color=#ff0000][u][b]12/9/2020[/b][/u]
[b]THIS MOD IS [u]OUTDATED[/u] AND NO LONGER BEING SUPPORTED. 
I give permission to anyone that wants to use/alter my modified sprites.[/b][/color][/size]


Replacement sprites for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ NPCs (created by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46021252]FlashShifter[/url]﻿) to better match [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites (now Content Patcher and v1.4 ready)[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url]﻿. Also inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4264]Shie's Portraits[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/72274698]Shielia[/url]﻿. I plan to continuously update this as Flash adds new sprites and animations to SVE.


NOTE: Poltergeister has since released sprites for SVE! Make sure you check them out! I'll continue to update my mod, so choose either one or mix and match! :D
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4857]Slightly Cuter Characters - SVE Edition[/url] ﻿
**[i]You can disable any of my characters to allow [u][b]full compatibility[/b][/u] with Poltergeister's mod!
[/i]


Includes full sprite sheets for...
- Andy
- Olivia (1.0 and 2.0)
- Susan
- Victor (1.0 and 2.0)
- Sophia
- Marlon
- Morris
- Alesia
- Isaac
- Claire
- Camilla
- Morgan
- Scarlett
- Character World Sprites (found in Joja Mart/Adventurer's Guild)


[b][u]Config Options:[/u][/b]
  "Noses":
﻿True = Everyone has noses (default)
﻿False = No one has noses

  "OliviaNew": 
﻿True = Olivia 2.0 (default)
﻿False = Olivia 1.0

  "VictorNew": 
﻿True = Victor 2.0 (default)
﻿False = Victor 1.0

  "OliviaShortWeddingDress": 
﻿True = Uses optional short dress
﻿False = Uses long wedding dress (default)

  "VictorTieWeddingSuit":
﻿True = Uses optional suit with tie
﻿False = Uses classy suit with gloves (default)

  "MarlonOriginalStyleFlowerDance": 
﻿True = Normal outfit recolored 
﻿False = Unique "traditional" style outfit (default)

  "Enable[Name]":
﻿True = This mod will alter that character's sprites. (default)
﻿False = The character's sprites will [b]not[/b] be changed.


[u][b]How to Install:[/b][/u]
1. Properly install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
3. [i](OPTIONAL) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites (now Content Patcher and v1.4 ready)[/url], highly recommended
3.5 - Go to  [CP] Slightly Cuter Characters/config and make sure "UseSVE" is set to "True"![/i]
4. [b]*You [u]MUST[/u] properly install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url] before my mod*[/b]
5. Extract the ZIP file to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
6. Finished!
